story: Sophie is in the garden. Big red and yellow leaves are falling from the trees. Sophie sees a tiny fairy sitting on a leaf. [emotion:QT/surprised] The fairy has bright purple wings. Sophie picks up a red leaf and gives it to the fairy. [emotion:QT/happy] The fairy puts the leaf on a big pile of leaves. Sophie picks up more leaves. [emotion:QT/happy] Sophie and the fairy make a tall, crunchy pile together. The wind blows three leaves away. [emotion:QT/afraid] The fairy catches the leaves and brings them back. [emotion:QT/happy]
